robot.name: Persona AI Humanoid
robot.status_notes: Persona AI is developing a Gen 1 industrial humanoid for shipyard welding and heavy industry. No official height, weight, payload, runtime, or speed have been published. Welding demos so far are teleoperated or not disclosed as autonomous. Partnerships with HD Hyundai, ABS, and SSE Steel are agreements/pilots, not confirmed deployments.

height.notes: No height published in reviewed numbered sources.

weight.notes: No weight published in reviewed numbered sources.

payload.notes: No payload published in reviewed numbered sources.

runtime.notes: No runtime or endurance figure published.

battery.notes: No battery capacity or chemistry published.

degrees_of_freedom.notes: No total DoF published in any reviewed source.

walking_speed.notes: No walking speed or locomotion specification published.

hands.description: Persona AI website states the modular platform is compatible with industrial tools. ABS MOU notes the robotic hand technology is partly based on NASA's robotic hand technology. Podcast show notes state the robotic hand allows flexibility in using existing tools.

actuators.description: No actuator specifications published. Persona AI describes a modular industrial robot platform designed to integrate with standard industrial tools.

availability.notes: No public price, purchase path, or waitlist found. Persona AI mentions a robotics-as-a-service (RaaS) business model but provides no pricing or availability.

manipulation_dexterity.summary: Persona AI product page claims strong and capable of fine dexterity and a modular platform compatible with industrial tools. ABS MOU says technology is partly based on NASA's robotic hand technology. An official video title indicates Gen 1 welding with 'Hand on the Torch'. A directory headline reports a successful teleoperated welding demo.
caveats: No video transcript or timestamp review; teleoperation status for official welding demo is not disclosed.
No hand DoF, grip strength, or dexterity metrics published.
Directory headline is secondary, not primary evidence.

autonomy_task_execution.summary: No evidence of autonomous task execution. Persona AI website link text indicates teleoperation precedes autonomy. A directory headline reports a teleoperated welding demo. No autonomous operation claims or demos found.
caveats: No autonomous task execution demonstrated or claimed.
Teleoperation status for official demo not disclosed, but reported teleoperated welding demo indicates current mode.

mobility_whole_body_control.summary: A directory headline reports Persona AI 'Takes Gen 1 Humanoid for a Stroll', suggesting walking, but no video evidence or locomotion specs are available. No walking speed or balance data published.
caveats: Headline is from a directory, not an official or primary source.
No walking speed, stability, or whole-body control metrics found.

perception_scene_understanding.summary: No sensor specifications or perception demonstrations found in reviewed sources. Podcast mentions AI progress in processing and vision, but no robot-specific evidence.
caveats: No perception specs or autonomous vision-guided tasks published.

human_interaction.summary: Persona AI website describes humanoids as collaborative teammates that work alongside supervisors and crews, and says they are designed to assist rather than replace skilled labor. No interactive demos or HRI metrics found.
caveats: No demonstrated conversational, collaborative, or safety-rated interaction evidence.

endurance_reliability.summary: No runtime, battery, duty cycle, or reliability data published. Persona AI website claims 'machine level endurance' but provides no figures or test results.
caveats: No endurance or reliability metrics found.

human_environment_fit.summary: Persona AI says robots are designed for real work environments such as shipyards, construction sites, and energy infrastructure. ABS MOU notes humanoids can move and operate in spaces designed for humans. No height, weight, or safety certification for human fit published.
caveats: No physical dimensions or safety certifications found.
Humanoid form factor implied but not explicitly specified in primary sources.

deployment_commercial_proof.summary: Multiple early-stage partnerships announced: HD Hyundai agreement with initial delivery expected within 18 months; ABS MOU; Louisiana/SSE Steel pilot with customer quote. No actual deployment or operational metrics found.
caveats: No robots delivered to customers; all are agreements, MOUs, or pilots.
HD Hyundai delivery timeline is company projection, not confirmed by Hyundai in primary source.
POSCO partnership appears only in directory summary.

accessibility_value.summary: No price or purchase path. Persona AI mentions RaaS model to eliminate upfront capital investments for clients, but no pricing or RaaS terms are published.
caveats: Not for sale; no RaaS terms or availability disclosed.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: Persona AI Humanoid is a first-generation industrial humanoid targeting shipyard welding and heavy industry. It has no published physical specifications, no autonomous execution evidence, and no actual customer deployment. The strongest evidence is an official demo title indicating welding and multiple early-stage partnership agreements.
strongest_positive_evidence: Official video title 'Hand on the Torch: Gen 1 Welds in a Real Industrial Environment' suggests welding capability.
HD Hyundai agreement with initial delivery expected within 18 months.
SSE Steel COO quote confirming shop-floor pilot.
ABS MOU adapting NASA-derived robotic hand technology for shipyards.
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No height, weight, payload, runtime, battery, or walking speed published.
No autonomous task execution; teleoperation is the disclosed route.
No actual customer deployment or operational metrics.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit any deployed robots at HD Hyundai, ABS, or SSE Steel; only agreements/pilots.
Do not credit autonomous welding; teleoperation is the current mode.
Do not infer specifications from directory headlines or generic statements.
Do not treat RaaS model as an actual price or availability.

currentness.currentness_notes: Persona AI Humanoid is the current first-generation industrial humanoid platform as of 2026-10-29. No successor model has been announced in the reviewed sources.

excluded_claims.reason: No official specifications were found in any reviewed source.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: Persona AI Humanoid is a first-generation industrial humanoid prototype from Persona AI (Houston) targeting shipyard welding, fabrication, construction, and energy. It has no published height, weight, payload, runtime, or speed. Evidence includes official claims of modular design and NASA-derived robotic hand technology, an agreement with HD Hyundai for shipyard robots with delivery expected within 18 months, an ABS MOU, and a Louisiana/SSE Steel pilot. The only direct demo evidence is an official video title 'Hand on the Torch: Gen 1 Welds in a Real Industrial Environment'; teleoperation status is not disclosed, and a directory headline reports a teleoperated welding demo. Autonomy is not demonstrated; the company states teleoperation precedes autonomy. No price or RaaS terms are available.
strongest_evidence: Official video title 'Hand on the Torch: Gen 1 Welds in a Real Industrial Environment' (evidence_009).
HD Hyundai agreement with initial delivery expected within 18 months (evidence_003).
SSE Steel COO quote confirming pilot on shop floor (evidence_008).
ABS MOU adapting NASA robotic hand technology for shipyards (evidence_007).
weakest_evidence: No height, weight, payload, runtime, battery, or walking speed published.
No autonomous task execution; welding demo teleoperated or not disclosed.
No actual customer deployment; all partnerships are pilots/agreements.
known_do_not_credit: Do not credit deployed robots at HD Hyundai, ABS, or SSE Steel.
Do not infer specifications from directory headlines.
Do not treat RaaS as a set price.
